status: implemented and verified; application speedup not demonstrated

protocol.boolean_order: CPU/Metal alternated within each process; first backend alternates each repeat
protocol.timed: filter allocation/reuse, copies, command encoding, submission, wait and mask copy; four-request cases include wakeup and join; booleanOperation only for boolean benchmark
protocol.untimed: shader compilation and input/oracle preparation, warmup, validation/serialization
protocol.compiler_flags: harness c++ -O3 -std=c++17; libraries from CMake Release; same harness source for both variants
protocol.isolation: no concurrent builds, architecture analysis, tests or profiling; external load, clocks and temperature uncontrolled
protocol.intervals: observed range of four process medians, not confidence intervals

selection.budget: unchanged 128 MiB active / 64 MiB idle / 4 active calls

architecture.visual_inspection: Final hybrid Metal detail inspected in IAB; both directions, includes separate from calls

exploration.decision: keep original linear kernel for small and one-axis batches; do not use exploratory timings as final hybrid results

limits: No full CAD document timing, frame-rate measurement or native visual CAD QA in this intervention.
The 256-side prism boolean uses the retained linear path; its timing spread cannot establish a benefit of the 2D kernel.
Only Apple M1 tested; threshold and threadgroup choice may differ on other GPUs.
No CUDA/NVIDIA hardware compilation or new numerical surface port to Metal.
No desktop installation update, commit or push.
Objective-C Metal API sends and shader text are not C++ call edges; manual benchmark has catalog/includes only.
Shader/library and both compute pipelines are initialized outside timer; first-use startup cost is not measured.
